AwardsCoaches.why: One row per award given to a coach in a year; points at Coaches.

AwardsMisc.why: One row per Lester Patrick award given in a year to a person or team, named rather than keyed.

AwardsPlayers.why: One row per award given to a player in a year, keyed player, award and year; points at Master.

Coaches.why: A coach's record with one team in one season, keyed coach, year, team and stint; points at the team-season.

CombinedShutouts.why: One row per game in which two goalies shared a shutout, dated by year, month and day.

Goalies.why: A goalie's season statistics per team stint, keyed player, year and stint.

GoaliesSC.why: A goalie's Stanley Cup final statistics for a year, keyed player and year.

GoaliesShootout.why: A goalie's shootout statistics per season stint; seven distinct years across 480 rows.

HOF.why: One row per Hall of Fame member, keyed hofID with name, category and induction year; Master points at it.

Master.why: One row per person (player or coach) with names, ids in other sources and birth and death details; every player table points at it.

Scoring.why: A skater's season statistics per team stint, keyed player, year and stint.

ScoringSC.why: A skater's Stanley Cup final statistics for a year, by player, year and team; fourteen distinct years.

ScoringShootout.why: A skater's shootout statistics per season stint; seven distinct years across 2,072 rows.

ScoringSup.why: Supplementary power-play and short-handed assists per player per year; four distinct years.

SeriesPost.why: One playoff series in a year, pointing at the winning and losing team-season.

TeamSplits.why: A team's home, road and month-by-month record for one season, keyed year and team.

TeamVsTeam.why: A team's season record against one opponent, keyed year, team and opponent.

Teams.why: A team's record for one season, keyed year and team; coach, player and series tables point at it.

TeamsHalf.why: A team's record for each half of a split season, keyed year, team and half.

TeamsPost.why: A team's postseason totals for one year, keyed year and team.

TeamsSC.why: A team's Stanley Cup final totals for one year, keyed year and team.

abbrev.why: Fifty-eight codes labelled with full names by type (playoff, division, round, conference); several tables' code columns use it, none declared.
